result.topic_en: Euler derives the variation of a function Z of x, y, p, q, r by differentiating with respect to the auxiliary variable t while holding x fixed, and begins treating integral expressions of the form ∫Z dx.
result.transcription:
VARIATIONVM TRACTANDI. 39
erit per regulas generales differentiandi functiones duarum variabilium
$(\frac{dp}{dt})=(\frac{d\,dy}{dx\,dt})$; $(\frac{dq}{dt})=(\frac{d^3y}{dx^2dt})$; $(\frac{dr}{dt})=(\frac{d^4y}{dx^3dt})$ etc.
vbi meminiffe iuuabit formulam verbi gratia $(\frac{d^3y}{dx^2.dt})$ prodire, fi functio $y$ ter differentietur et duabus vicibus fola $x$, vna vice autem fola $t$ variabilis fumatur tum vero qualibet differentiatione differentialia fimplicia $dx$ vel $dt$ abiiciantur.

8. His expeditis fit iam $Z$ functio quaecunque ipfarum $x, y, p, q, r$ etc., hic quidem nullo adhuc refpectu habito ad variabilem $t$, quippe quae tantum in fubfidium variationis introducitur, atque differentiatione more folito facta prodeat
$dZ=M\,dx+N\,dy+P\,dp+Q\,dq+R\,dr$ etc.
nunc igitur pro variatione feu $dt(\frac{dZ}{dt})$ inuenienda fcribi debebit vt fequitur:
$dx=0$; $dy=dt(\frac{dy}{dt})$, $dp=dt(\frac{dp}{dt})=dt(\frac{d\,dy}{dx\,dt})$,
$dq=dt(\frac{d^3y}{dx^2dt})$, $dr=dt(\frac{d^4y}{dx^3dt})$ etc.
atque variatio quaefita erit
$dt(\frac{dZ}{dt})=N\,dt(\frac{dy}{dt})+P\,dt(\frac{d\,dy}{dx\,dt})+Q\,dt(\frac{d^3y}{dx^2dt})+R\,dt(\frac{d^4y}{dx^3dt})$ etc.
vnde fequitur diuifione per $dt$ facta fore:
$(\frac{dZ}{dt})=N(\frac{dy}{dt})+P(\frac{d\,dy}{dx\,dt})+Q(\frac{d^3y}{dx^2dt})+R(\frac{d^4y}{dx^3dt})$ etc.

9. Sit nunc etiam expreffio quaecunque tertii generis propofita $\int Z\,dx$, vbi $Z$ fit functio quaecunque

items.quote: nunc igitur pro variatione feu $dt(\frac{dZ}{dt})$ inuenienda fcribi debebit vt fequitur
items.english: now therefore, in order to find the variation, i.e. $dt(\frac{dZ}{dt})$, one must write as follows

items.quote: Sit nunc etiam expreffio quaecunque tertii generis propofita $\int Z\,dx$, vbi $Z$ fit functio quaecunque
items.english: Let there now also be proposed any expression of the third kind, $\int Z\,dx$, where $Z$ is any function whatever
